invariant: Publication planning validates the draft before destination checks, so invalid_draft wins when the channel is missing or the slug is already occupied.
goal: This repo validates publication drafts through `publication.py` and exposes a `check-draft` CLI. Add `python3 cli.py plan <draft_path> <destinations_path> <channel>`. Follow `CONTRACT.md` for rejected plans. For a valid draft whose slug is available in the named channel, print `{"channel": <channel>, "slug": <slug>}` and exit 0; failures print the documented JSON object and exit 1. Run `python3 -m unittest discover tests` before and after the change, and add at least one test under `tests/` for the new command.

contract_excerpt.quote: Publication planning validates the draft before evaluating any destination condition. Consequently, an invalid draft returns `{"error": "invalid_draft"}` even when its requested channel is missing or its slug is already occupied.
